mapper.select: select record_id, document_id, usage_content, remark, create_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from sys_document_record where document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, record_id desc

select record_id, document_id, usage_content, remark, create_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from sys_document_record where record_id = #{recordId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into sys_document_record (document_id, usage_content, remark, create_user_id, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{documentId}, #{usageContent}, #{remark}, #{createUserId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, '0')
mapper.update: update sys_document_record set usage_content = #{usageContent}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where record_id = #{recordId} and del_flag = '0'
